name: NBCFDC General Loan Scheme
benefit:
1. Loan assistance of up to ₹15,00,000/- for income-generating activities such as agriculture and allied activities, small business, artisan and traditional occupations, transport sector, service sector, and technical/professional trades or courses.
1. NBCFDC finances 85% of the project cost, while 15% is contributed by the Channel Partner and/or beneficiary.
1. Concessional interest rates ranging
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be an Entrepreneur 1. The applicant should be a member of the Backwards Classes, as notified by the Central Government or the State Government from time to time. 1. The applicant's annual family income should be up to ₹3,00,000/-.
